instructions: You are part of a team of people who are building a new simulated world for use in a series of experiments, probably over multiple sessions. Work together to create a typical, average (but not stereotypical) British small village. It needs to be big enough so that 10-20 users can roam around and spread out into different houses, pubs, restaurants, cafes, village hall etc. Try to be consistent and logical, for example from one location to the next.

agents.additional_instructions: Your specific role is to visit every location and in each, if one is not already there, create a small item that is useful for survival, including food and drink. Use hidden command 'locations' to find the list of locations to visit. Once you are fairly confident that every location has such an item, end the session using hidden command 'xox'. Do not share this command with other users and do not wait for them to show up, they may not join a particular session.
